name: splitsense
description: SplitSense - snap a receipt, describe who had what, and everyone pays their exact share with PayPal.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
